verdict.rationale: ReelMimic lets a creator scrub to any second of the finished video and leave notes (docs-7), or request changes in chat (gh-1). The video is built shot-by-shot, with each part tracked and reviewed separately (docs-4, gh-2), which implies segment-level fixes, but the docs never say a fix re-renders only that segment rather than the whole video. Nothing covers extending a clip's length; the 'Extending' item refers to adding styles or engines to the software, so it does not count. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that a single segment is regenerated without a full re-render, any capability to extend a clip, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
